cause.summary: Pre-fix, the description editor's unmount flush fired on React StrictMode's simulated unmount and left a phantom save in flight on the still-live saver instance; the reopened peek's Retry joined that request instead of starting its own, so the click produced zero HTTP requests and zero UI change.
cause.worker_fix: createUnmountFlush in web/src/tracker/detail/descriptionDraft.ts, wired at web/src/tracker/detail/Editors.tsx (drops the unmount save when StrictMode's simulated unmount immediately remounts).
cause.measured_after_fix: trusted click -> exactly 1 PATCH, Unsaved changes bar cleared in 32 ms, stored description equals the draft.
